completeness.why: getDateWithSkippedWeekend now takes the enable flag and decides both whether and how to move the date; all four sites drop their outer skipWeekend ternary/if and pass their own enable field and mode. The sites all normalise the flag the same way (=== true), and getNextDate additionally folds in noSkipWeekend, a variation that exists only at that site, so none of them settles the rule differently.

interface.why: A single boolean enable parameter captures the real variation and each caller maps its own mode field name; the default of true and the repeated '=== true' coercion at every call site are slightly awkward, and noSkipWeekend is folded into the flag rather than named.

disguised_duplication.where: The four local ternaries are removed, not reshaped; only the trivial '=== true' normalisation is repeated at call sites.
